title: Transmit-arbiter input cone is 39-42 logic levels at 50 MHz; slack depends on placement
body:
[A10] The processor's transmit-arbiter input cone is 39 to 42 logic levels deep at the shipping 50 MHz clock (20 ns), so its setup slack depends on placement noise.

**Measured** (AX7101, shipping 1x1 TDM8, three-directive sweep), setup WNS in ns:

| Parent tree | eppo | asl | eto | Worst path |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| dev `fa450d30` | +0.244 | +0.026 | +0.056 | SDRAM (not this path) |
| parent lane at `b2c81239` | +0.120 | +0.142 | +0.001 | rx-validator `hdr_src_mac_r_reg[0]` to the tx-arbiter FSM, 39 levels, 19.728 ns |
| parent lane at `4e1ddee9` | +0.151 | +0.101 | -0.209 | notification `wr_ix_r_reg[0]_replica_4` to tx-arbiter `slot_r_reg[0]/D`, 42 levels, 20.130 ns |
| dev `28f9666f` | +0.032 | +0.345 | +0.164 | (best asl) |

The parent lane (kebag-logic/milan-fpga#645) adds no logic on this path. Its added cells move placement enough for one directive to fail.

**Acceptance:**
1. Find the transmit-arbiter input cones above 20 levels: the notification slot select, the rx-validator header fields, and any others. Report each with its levels and endpoints.
2. Add a register stage on each, or restructure it, so that no path into the transmit arbiter exceeds about 20 levels. Keep cycle-level behaviour equivalent, or grade the extra cycle in tb/pp_top and tb/aecp_notify with planted mutants.
3. Show the OOC 1x1 area delta (#638 recipe). Have the parent three-directive sweep show all three directives at +0.03 ns or better on the merged pin.

Relates to kebag-logic/milan-fpga#645 and #640 (Mark II moves this logic to the core in the split build; the all-fabric build keeps it).
